title: Zeus Juice Pegasus E-Liquid 50ml Shortfill
description: Pegasus by Zeus Juice is an irresistible candy blend with a sweet fruit base layer of succulent grapes and juicy strawberries, all given a delightful sherbet fizz on the exhale. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vape mods and sub-ohm tanks .
